bio.text: Christopher Rabb, a Democrat, has represented District 200 in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives since December 1, 2016, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for Pennsylvania's 3rd Congressional District.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Yale University in 1992 and a master's degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 2006.
According to Ballotpedia, he worked as an aide to U.S. Sen. Carol Moseley Braun and has taught at Temple University's Fox School of Business and Drexel University's LeBow College of Business.
